method: first-match-wins over commodities.json in array order through the real matcher (grocery/match-lib.ps1 New-CommodityMatcher + Resolve-Commodity, global exclude from global-exclude-lib.ps1): every unique name in the corpus is routed before and after each scenario; a change is a name whose winning commodity differs. Token hits are reported beside routing changes to show the proxy gap.
